issues.description: Method name mismatch for adding a StockIngredient: the problem statement UML (and the reference solution) specify a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient): void, but the starter/template Stock class defines this operation as addItem(StockIngredient): void. This naming inconsistency between the template code and the assignment/UML will confuse students and can cause compilation errors if they implement SealSaloon or other code that calls addToStockIngredients as described in the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across all artifacts. Rename the template Stock method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) so the starter code matches the UML and the reference solution, or alternatively update the problem statement/UML and the solution to use addItem consistently. Ensure the method signature (parameter type and return type) remains void StockIngredient -> void so student code compiles as expected.
